LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.2 PRONUNCIATION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Listening and Speaking 7.1.2 Pronunciation
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 7.1.2 Pronunciation, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to articulate sounds correctly? 2. How does stress in words affect meaning in sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the different realisations of the /f / as in father, phase and rough. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication,

2. search offline and online for words with the sound /ŋ/ / and the blends /ŋɡ/. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,

3. say the words with /ŋ/ and /ŋɡ/. Learners with speech difficulties could 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the different realisations of the /f / as in father, phase and rough. Learners with speech difficulties could use alternative and augmentative modes of communication,
2. search offline and online for words with the sound /ŋ/ / and the blends /ŋɡ/. Learners with manipulation difficulties could use alternative functional parts of the body, use adapted digital devices, assistive technology or be assisted,
3. say the words with /ŋ/ and /ŋɡ/. Learners with speech difficulties could 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 7.1.2 Pronunciation together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy as the learner interacts with digital technology as they search online for words with the sounds /ŋ/ / and

the blends / /ŋɡ/.

• Communication as the learner speak clearly and effectively as they read the sentences in pairs, putting emphasis on

different parts of the sentence to bring out different meanings.

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as the learner exercises resilience as they work with others to construct sentences on the theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship education as learners promotes social cohesion as they discuss the effect on meaning when stress is placed on

different parts of the sentence.

Suggested Learning Resources: Dictionaries, Newspapers, Charts and realia, Resource persons, Audio recordings
